findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_reply · Private data: talk_to_moran, learn_from_moran, date_with_moran, study_with_moran, human_day_with_moran, intimate_evening_with_moran, leave_details · Public sink: leave_details · Destructive: talk_to_moran, learn_from_moran, date_with_moran, study_with_moran, human_day_with_moran, intimate_evening_with_moran.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_reply · Private data: talk_to_moran, learn_from_moran, date_with_moran, study_with_moran, human_day_with_moran, intimate_evening_with_moran, leave_details · Public sink: leave_details · Destructive: talk_to_moran, learn_from_moran, date_with_moran, study_with_moran, human_day_with_moran, intimate_evening_with_moran

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
